verdict.rationale: Vercel automatically creates a preview environment, with its own URL, for every push and every branch. Teams can also define custom environments with their own variables and comment on previews together, so parallel work is supported. However, the 'unlimited' part of the story is undercut by documented platform limits, including concurrent deployments of 1 on Hobby and up to 500 otherwise, plus daily deployment caps on Hobby. Missing for 10: evidence of truly unlimited environments, detail on how isolation works between preview environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up unlimited isolated environments so my whole team can ship simultaneously

citations.quote: Connect your Git repository to deploy on every push, with automatic preview environments for testing changes before production.
Connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch.
Manage local, preview, production, and custom environments and the variables each one uses.
